description: The plot illustrates the relationship between co-occurrence number and ACC (%). The x-axis is labeled “Co-occurrence Number” and uses a logarithmic scale, ranging from 10⁰ to 10³, with tick labels at 10¹, 10², and 10³. The y-axis is labeled “ACC (%)” and uses a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 55, with tick labels at 5-unit intervals. A black line with circular markers, representing “Base”, begins at approximately (10⁰, 32%) and ends at approximately (10³, 46%). A brown line with diamond markers, representing “MEND”, begins at approximately (10⁰, 35%) and ends at approximately (10³, 53%). A blue line with triangular markers, representing “FT”, begins at approximately (10⁰, 33%) and ends at approximately (10³, 42%). A red line with downward-pointing triangular markers, representing “IKE”, begins at approximately (10⁰, 33%) and ends at approximately (10³, 40%). A green line with square markers, representing “ROME”, begins at approximately (10⁰, 43%) and ends at approximately (10³, 54%).
